finding: None of the v0.0.0.8 module families is reachable from the running application. Every one of them is required only by the test tree. The live message path — src/index.js -> src/core/app.js -> src/core/inbound-turn.js — still runs the single-user Owner flow it ran before this work started.

what_this_means_for_the_seal.still_true: Every acceptance check recorded in docs/evidence/** was really executed against the real modules on the exact target subject. No result was fabricated and no test was weakened.
what_this_means_for_the_seal.materially_qualified: Those results are properties of the MODULES, not yet properties of the RUNNING PRODUCT. AC-006, AC-007, AC-008 and AC-009 are the sharpest cases: the Owner boundary and cross-user isolation hold for UserContext and UserScopedRepository, but inbound-turn.js never constructs a UserContext, so a real WeChat message today is still handled on the single-user Owner path with none of those guards on it.
what_this_means_for_the_seal.not_claimed_before_and_still_not_claimed: AC-039, and the live halves of AC-035, AC-040 and AC-050, were already recorded as activation_pending.
what_this_means_for_the_seal.correction: PG-8's CONDITIONAL_PASS should be read as 'the v0.0.0.8 overlay is built and proved' and NOT as 'the v0.0.0.8 product behaviour is live'. The earlier evidence did not say this plainly enough, and this file exists to say it.

why_it_happened.taskpack_design: machine/overlay_map.json declares strategy 'additive_overlay_then_anchor_based_integration' with automatic_mutation false, so the modules are correctly additive and were correctly not auto-wired.
why_it_happened.the_half_that_was_missed: That strategy has two halves. The additive overlay was built and proved. The anchor-based integration — actually calling the overlay from the live path at the declared anchors — was not performed. CB-630 is titled 'UserContext 全链路' (full chain) and was sealed on module-level proof; the chain it names does not yet reach inbound-turn.js.
why_it_happened.responsibility: This is a gap in the execution, not a limitation of the environment. It needed no credential and no target host.
